description: Equity vesting schedule — Stock option / RSU vesting calculator: vested and unvested shares as of a date, cliff date and cliff shares, next vest date, fully-vested date, upcoming vest events, and optional value at an FMV (with strike: intrinsic value, exercise cost, underwater flag). Supports monthly/quarterly/annual vesting, any cliff, and back-loaded schedules like 5;15;40;40. Params: shares, start (YYYY-MM-DD); optional years (4), cliff (months, 12), frequency, schedule, as_of, fmv, strike. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
